outcome: Maternal adverse outcomes (admission to ICU, maternal mortality, viral pneumonia, oxygen supplementation, severe COVID-19 course)
Fetal and neonatal adverse outcomes (stillbirth, neonatal death, transfer to NICU)
cohort: The study included 1490 pregnant women with clinically confirmed COVID-19 infection enrolled at any stage of pregnancy.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus combined with periconceptional overweight or obesity was independently associated with a severe maternal course of COVID-19 and moderately affected neonatal outcomes, particularly when insulin was required and COVID-19 was diagnosed with or after GDM diagnosis.
